page.overview:
Who is Satan?

Satan, also known as The Great Beast, is a supporting character in Invincible, debuting from Season 3 to 4.

He is an ancient demon lord residing in Under Realm, who was dethroned by Volcanikka, a major threat to both the Under Realm and the surface world, and stripped of his power, leading him to seek to reclaim his former status as its supreme ruler.

Satan enlisted the aid of several demons, including Damien Darkblood, who had been banished back to Hell by Cecil Stedman and the Global Defense Agency. After failing to stop Volcanikka, Satan and Damien attempted to summon Omni-Man to Hell for assistance, but instead inadvertently summoned Invincible. Despite this, Invincible aided them, and together they helped Satan reclaim his power and throne, ultimately defeating Volcanikka.

With his crown removed, Satan appeared as a short, elderly demon with red skin, a short tail, yellow sclera with white irises, and grey hair featuring a white geometric-patterned shaved section.
